paraphrase: Finite interpretations for the nine derivations of round 4 (revisited leads): for each premise other than excluded middle, a one- or two-element model in which the other premises hold and the conclusion fails, and one joint model per map in which every premise and conclusion holds with a nonvacuous instance (a potency grounded and moved by a distinct actual, simply prior being; a matter-form composite with distinct esse and essence; a necessary being caused in every respect; an intellectual being at the top grade; an occurring thought whose bearer exists, exercises intellect, causes, has power and is concrete; two beings moving and causing each other per se). Satisfiability and omission only; no model is claimed to describe reality.
